data.name: 樂園餘燼
data.detailed_description:
Exploration

Randomly generated dungeons offer unpredictable adventures with each exploration. Find keys, discover treasures, and gradually delve into the deepest parts of the dungeon.

Combat

Encountering enemies in the dungeon will trigger a chessboard-style combat mode. Utilize the terrain's elevation differences, skill range, and character traits to devise tactics and defeat various enemies.

Story

In the distant past, a highly advanced civilization once existed, but it has vanished without a trace, and no one knows the true reason. Today, people rely on burning "fire" to maintain spatial stability and defend against monster invasions. However, an accident twisted the shelter into a labyrinth, and companions were scattered in the chaos. To save the shelter and find their companions, the protagonist delves into the labyrinth, gradually uncovering the truth behind the ancient civilization's demise.

data.short_description: A game that combines dungeon exploration with turn-based strategy combat. Explore randomly generated dungeons, challenge yourself in strategically deep battles, and uncover the hidden truths of an ancient civilization!
